description:
Fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work.

Skriuw is a fast, local-first desktop app for notes, journaling, and knowledge work. Version 2 keeps the workspace in local SQLite storage with portable archives and Git-backed history.
Changes since v2-v0.55.0
- chore(v2): release v2-v0.55.1
- perf(workspace): play the theme tile shimmer once and open the diagram expand without showModal (#598)
- perf(workspace): cut WebKitGTK style work on Tasks, focus moves and dialogs (#596)
- fix(sidebar): move to the first and last tree row with Home and End (#597)
- fix(release): dispatch every package channel after publishing
